question.title: How long does the planet Earth take to complete one full rotation on its axis, causing day and night?
question.description: Source: Current Affairs Study Material — Area 11 (Page 245)
question.subject: Geography
question.explanation: Earth completes one rotation on its axis in approximately 24 hours, producing day and night.
question.generalExplanation: Earth completes one rotation on its axis in approximately 24 hours, producing day and night.
